code: (async()=>{const E=window.__echoes;const s=m=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,m));const errs=[]; window.addEventListener('error',ev=>errs.push({msg:ev.message, stack:(ev.error&&ev.error.stack)?String(ev.error.stack).slice(0,700):null}));const steps=[];E.cmd('startRun');await s(150);steps.push('startRun ok');E.cmd('skipToRoom',8);await s(600);steps.push('skip8 '+E.cmd('runState').phase);try{const r=E.cmd('bossHp',0.2,true);steps.push('bossHp '+JSON.stringify(r));}catch(e){steps.push('bossHp THREW '+e.message);}await s(300);steps.push('afterBossHp '+JSON.stringify(E.cmd('runState').boss));try{const r=E.cmd('killAllEnemies');steps.push('killAll '+r);}catch(e){steps.push('killAll THREW '+e.message);}await s(400);try{const r=E.cmd('killBoss');steps.push('killBoss '+r);}catch(e){steps.push('killBoss THREW '+e.message);}await s(900);steps.push('after phase='+E.cmd('runState').phase+' boss='+JSON.stringify(E.cmd('runState').boss));return {steps,errs};})()
